favoriteTeamIds_help: Open the dropdown to load the current NFL team list from the running adapter. Select one or more favorites, then use Save in the admin toolbar. The adapter writes isFavorite on each team's object and on every game where that team plays.
pollIntervalLiveSeconds_help: How often to refresh the scoreboard while NFL games are in progress (15–300 s). When no game is live the adapter polls every 5 minutes automatically.
